metadata.title: GameShelf
metadata.description: Track, organize, and discover your video game library.

auth.setupComplete: Setup complete. Sign in with your new account.

loginError.input: Enter an email and a password, then try again.
loginError.generic: We couldn't sign you in right now. Check your connection and try again.

setup.title: Set up your shelf
setup.description: This account is created once and becomes the owner of this GameShelf instance.
setup.inputError: Enter an email and a password, then try again.
setup.genericError: We couldn't create your account right now. Please try again.

common.errorBody: The shelf didn't respond. Check your connection, then try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure game recognition and game-database access.
settings.loadError: Couldn't load the LLM settings. Reload to try again.

llm.heading: Game recognition
llm.baseUrlHint: The OpenAI-compatible endpoint your server exposes (e.g. Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter).
llm.baseUrlRequired: Enter the base URL before saving.
llm.customModelHint: Enter the exact model name your server exposes — local models have arbitrary names.
llm.customKeyHint: Local servers typically accept any non-empty value. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
llm.keyWillRemove: The key will be removed when you save.
llm.testHint: The test uses the saved settings. Save your changes before testing.

test.ok: Connection succeeded — the provider accepted the request.
test.not_configured: Game recognition isn't configured yet. Save a base URL and an API key first.
test.unauthorized: The provider rejected the API key. Check the key and try again.
test.model_not_found: The configured model does not exist for this provider. Choose a different model.
test.rate_limited: The provider rate-limited the request. Wait a moment and try again.
test.timeout: The provider did not respond in time. Try again.
test.bad_response: The provider returned an unexpected response.
test.network: Couldn't reach the provider. Check the connection and try again.
test.server_error: The provider had a server error. Try again later.
test.fallback: The connection test returned an unexpected result.

error.save: We couldn't save the LLM settings. Check your connection and try again.
error.test: Couldn't run the connection test. Check your connection and try again.

preferences.heading: Preferences
preferences.body: Choose the interface language and theme.
preferences.error: Couldn't save your preferences. Try again.

empty.body: Add a game by hand, or import photos of your shelf to fill it in.

noResults.body: Try broadening your search or removing a filter.

manualAdd.heading: Add a game
manualAdd.subheading: Enter a game by hand. Records added here aren’t linked to a game database.
manualAdd.noPlatforms: No platforms yet — create one to get started.
manualAdd.notLinked: Not linked to a game database.
manualAdd.compactHint: Adds the game with just a title and platform. Fill in the rest later from the catalog.
manualAdd.addCopyStatus: Added a copy of “{title}” — now {count, plural, one {1 copy} other {# copies}}.

error.titleMax: Title must be 255 characters or fewer.

import.title: Import from photos
import.subtitle: Photograph your shelf, pick the photos here, and we’ll recognise the games.

gate.disabled: Photo import is off because no LLM API key is set. Add a key in Settings, then come back — or add games by hand.
gate.unknown: We couldn’t read the LLM settings, so photo import is paused. Try again — or add games by hand.

import.providerNotice: Photos are sent to your configured LLM.
import.dropzone: Drop shelf photos here, browse, or paste (⌘V).
import.dropzoneHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC. Up to 20 MB each, up to 50 photos.

rejections.title: Some photos were not added.
rejections.unsupported: Unsupported file type. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.
rejections.tooMany: Only {limit, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} can be imported at once.

import.countsHint: If you know how many games are in a photo, add the number. We check it against what the model recognises and flag any difference. Leave it blank if you’d rather not count.

countError.notNumber: Enter a whole number, or leave it blank.
countError.range: Enter a number from 1 to {max}, or leave it blank.

import.heicError: We couldn’t read this HEIC photo.
import.ready: {count, plural, one {# photo ready ({size})} other {# photos ready ({size})}}

error.unavailable: Photo import is unavailable right now — no LLM API key is set.
error.generic: We couldn’t start the import. Check your connection and try again.

importProgress.title: Importing photos
importProgress.subtitle: You can leave this page — the import keeps running.
importProgress.subtitleDone: All {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} processed.

error.resume: We couldn’t resume the queue. Check your connection and try again.

importProgress.progressAria: {done} of {total, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} processed
importProgress.processed: {done} of {total, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} processed

llm.reason: The language model rejected the request.
llm.hint: Check your API key in Settings, then resume the import.

igdb.reason: The game database rejected its credentials.
igdb.hint: Fix the IGDB credentials in the server environment, then resume the import.

none.reason: Photo import is paused until the configuration is fixed.
none.hint: Fix the configuration, then resume the import.

summary.decision: {count, plural, one {# photo needs} other {# photos need}} your decision.
summary.working: Nothing needs your decision so far. We’ll flag anything that does as photos finish.
summary.allDone: All done. Nothing needs your decision.

photoSummary.added: {count, plural, =0 {No games added.} one {Added # game.} other {Added # games.}}
photoSummary.open: {count, plural, one {# title needs} other {# titles need}} your decision.
photoSummary.reviewed: You reviewed {count, plural, one {# flagged title} other {# flagged titles}}.

why.failed: We couldn’t finish this photo. Retry it. Games already added won’t be added twice.
why.unmatched: We couldn’t match these titles to the game database. For each one, pick a match, add it by hand, or dismiss it if it isn’t a game you own.
why.nothingFound: We didn’t recognize any games in this photo. Try a sharper photo with the spines facing the camera, or dismiss this one.
why.countFewer: You said this photo shows {declared, plural, one {# game} other {# games}}, but we recognized {recognized}. Add any missing games by hand, then dismiss this photo.
why.countMore: You said this photo shows {declared, plural, one {# game} other {# games}}, but we recognized {recognized}. Check the games added from it, then dismiss this photo.

reason.ambiguous: Several games match this title. Pick the right one.
reason.noPlatform: Found the game, but not which platform it’s for. Add it by hand and choose the platform.
reason.notFound: Not found in the game database. Check the spelling and search again, or add it by hand.

importAttention.loadError: We couldn’t load the flagged titles for this photo.
importAttention.allReviewed: Every flagged title from this photo is reviewed.
importAttention.confirmBody: It stops asking for a decision. Games already added from it stay in your catalog, and titles you haven’t reviewed are left out. You can’t undo this.

lookup.hint: Finds the game with its cover and details. Fix the title first if it’s misspelled. Matches for the selected platform come first.
lookup.titleTooShort: Enter at least 2 characters to search.
lookup.results: {count, plural, one {# match} other {# matches}} for “{title}”. Pick one to add it with its details.
lookup.noMatches: Nothing found for “{title}”. Fix the title and search again, or use Add to catalog.

error.search: We couldn’t reach the game database. Try again, or add the game manually.

error.retry: We couldn’t retry this photo. Check your connection and try again.
error.dismissPhoto: We couldn’t dismiss this photo. Check your connection and try again.
error.dismissItem: We couldn’t dismiss this item. Check your connection and try again.
error.savedDismissFailed: Added “{title}” to your catalog, but we couldn’t dismiss this flagged title. Dismiss it to finish reviewing this photo.
error.pick: We couldn’t pick this candidate. Check your connection and try again.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.subtitle: The canonical list every import matches against. Rename keeps the old name as an alias; merge moves games and keeps the merged name matchable.

importReview.title: Added by import — review
importReview.body: These platforms were created while importing for names that weren’t recognized. Keep them as they are, merge them into an existing platform, or rename them. Either way the name stays matchable.

add.title: Add a platform
add.body: Create a platform the import will match against. Names are compared case- and punctuation-insensitively.
add.conflict: It already exists — rename or merge it instead.

platforms.name: Name
platforms.showAll: Show empty and hidden reference platforms

empty.none: No platforms yet. Add one, or import games to create them.
empty.filtered: No platforms to show. Tick “Show empty and hidden reference platforms” to see the full list.

kindHint.import: Created by an import for a name it did not recognize. Keep it as is, or merge it into an existing platform.
kindHint.canonical: Part of the reference list synced from the game database. Matching targets, not user data.
kindHint.manual: A platform you added by hand.

platforms.renameHelp: The previous name is kept as an alias, so future imports still match it.
platforms.hideHint: Reference platforms can’t be deleted — hiding removes them from this list; Refresh platforms restores them.

confirmDelete.title: Delete “{name}”?
confirmDelete.body: This can’t be undone. A platform with games can’t be deleted — you’ll be offered a merge instead.
confirmDelete.blocked: It still has games, so it can’t be deleted yet.
confirmDelete.hint: Reassign its games first — merge it into another platform, or edit each game.

merge.title: Merge “{name}” into another platform
merge.willMove: {count, plural, one {# game will} other {# games will}} move to the target.
merge.move: Move {count, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} from “{source}”.
merge.none: There is no other platform to merge into yet. Add one first.
merge.confirm: Move {count, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} from “{source}” to “{target}”? “{source}” is kept as an alias so future imports still match it; the platform is then removed.

status.renamed: Renamed to “{name}”. The previous name is kept as an alias.

error.add: Couldn’t reach the shelf. Try again.
error.rename: We couldn’t rename this platform. Check your connection and try again.
error.update: We couldn’t update this platform. Check your connection and try again.
error.confirm: We couldn’t confirm this platform. Check your connection and try again.
error.delete: We couldn’t delete this platform. Check your connection and try again.
error.merge: We couldn’t merge the platform. Check your connection and try again.
error.refresh: Couldn’t refresh the platform list. Try again.

refresh.heading: Reference platforms
refresh.body: Reload the platform list from the game database. Hidden reference platforms come back; nothing is deleted.
refresh.summary: Platform list refreshed — {fetched} fetched, {created} added, {updated} updated, {unchanged} unchanged.
